verdict.rationale: GlitchTip explicitly claims Sentry API/protocol compatibility ('Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip'), and community users confirm using various Sentry SDKs/reporters (including newer ones like Svelte) successfully against GlitchTip, implying the ingestion protocol is open enough for compatible SDKs without an official GlitchTip SDK. However, GlitchTip's own docs don't publish the raw wire-format/protocol spec directly, and probes found no OpenAPI/swagger spec or machine-readable docs endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the actual envelope/DSN protocol format, a published OpenAPI spec, and confirmation of arbitrary custom (non-Sentry-lineage) clients succeeding.
